indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_rendition_canonical_text_search ON kb.rendition USING gin (to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, canonical_text))

views.query:
SELECT f.realization_id, f.release_id, f.fact_id, f.subject_id, f.property_id, f.object_value_id, f.qualification_value_id 
FROM data.fact AS f JOIN data.selection AS s ON s.realization_id = f.realization_id AND s.release_id = f.release_id AND s.fact_id = f.fact_id
